page.overview:
Who is Diamond Chicken?

Baby:Height: 0.35 BlocksWidth: 0.2 Blocks

Diamond chickens were a rare joke variant of chicken present in the April Fool's Java Edition 2.0 that lays Lapis Lazulis or Diamonds instead of eggs.

Diamond chickens spawn under normal chicken spawning conditions, but only with 7% chance.

As chickens were modified in 2.0 to display neutral behavior, diamond chickens are also neutral.
